definitions.explanation: A high school (or sometimes middle school) where a high percentage of students go on to university. These schools emphasize academic achievement and university entrance exam preparation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{進学校|しんがくこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: I attend a famous college-prep school.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{県内|けんない}→県内：27823_kennai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦トップ→トップ：03862_toppu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進学校|しんがくこう}だ。
examples.english: That high school is the top college-prep school in the prefecture.

examples.japanese: {進学校|しんがくこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われている→追う：02016_ou⟧。
examples.english: Since I entered a college-prep school, I'm busy studying every day.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{進学|しんがく}→進学：03256_shingaku⟧ (advancing to higher education) + {校|こう} (school). Literally 'a school for advancing to the next level of education.'

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, {進学校|しんがくこう} typically refers to high schools with high university acceptance rates, especially to prestigious universities. They are distinguished from {商業高校|しょうぎょうこうこう} (commercial high schools) or {工業高校|こうぎょうこうこう} (technical high schools), which prepare students for employment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧{進学校|しんがくこう} (famous prep school)
- ⟦{県内|けんない}→県内：27823_kennai⟧⟦トップ→トップ：03862_toppu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進学校|しんがくこう} (top prep school in the prefecture)
- {進学校|しんがくこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧ (to attend a prep school)
- ⟦{私立|しりつ}→私立：00370_shiritsu⟧{進学校|しんがくこう} (private college-prep school)
